# claude-p

> Emulates `claude -p` (not a drop-in or wire-compatible replacement) by driving the interactive `claude` UI inside an in-process zmux PTY session. Version 0.1.3, Zig 0.15.2, macOS and Linux (arm64/x64). Public Smithers Cloud factory at https://smithers.sh/smithersai/claude-p.

## Quick facts

- One-shot CLI: `claude-p [OPTIONS] [PROMPT]` (stdin or `--input-file` up to 16 MiB).
- Output formats: `text` (default), `json`, `stream-json` (requires `--verbose` in one-shot mode).
- Daemon CLI: `claude-p daemon [OPTIONS]` speaks NDJSON on stdin (`user`, `ping`, `interrupt`) and stdout (`system/init`, live transcript lines, per-turn `result`, `pong`, structured `interrupted` / watchdog error `result` frames).
- Rejected CLI flags (exit `2`): `-p`, `--print`, `--settings` (use `--extra-hook` or `--setting-json`), `--bare`, `--safe-mode`, `--no-session-persistence`, and the print-mode-only `--input-format`, `--json-schema`, `--max-budget-usd`, `--max-turns`, `--fallback-model`, `--include-partial-messages`, `--forward-subagent-text`, `--replay-user-messages`, `--verbose-thinking`.
- Exit codes: `0` success, `1` assistant `is_error`, `2` CLI/wrapper error, `124` every timeout (one-shot timeouts and daemon `session_start_timeout`/`idle_timeout`/`transcript_stalled`), `128+sig` after `SIGINT`/`SIGTERM`/`SIGHUP` (set by the native binary; the npm shim passes it through).
- Never mutates `~/.claude/`; uses per-run `$TMPDIR/claude-p-<pid>-<rand>/` FIFO + relay script.
- Smithers Cloud MCP: `https://smithers.sh/api/mcp` · Shared object store: `https://build.smithers.sh`.

## Coding factory, audit, wiki, and mythical history

- [Lighthouse Backpressure Audit](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/factory/audit/): Overview of Uphill continuous metrics, trust provenance, and live interactive Lighthouse gauges at https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/audit/.
- [Mythical History](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/history/): Chronological commit, release, review, and fuzzing bug-kill chronicle reconstructed from jj history.
- [Wiki: System Overview and World Model](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/wiki/): Module map, architecture diagram, and invariants.
- [Wiki: PTY Lifecycle, zmux Threading, and DEC Queries](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/wiki/pty-and-zmux/): EventSink threading rules and streaming DecDecoder.
- [Wiki: Startup Dialog FSM and macOS TTYHOG Safe Paste](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/wiki/startup-dialogs-and-paste/): Claude Code 2.1 trust dialog confirmation and PasteChunker.
- [Wiki: Nonce-Tagged Hook Relay and Ephemeral FIFO](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/wiki/hook-relay-and-fifo/): Inline settings, nonce verification, and PermissionRequest fail-fast.
- [Wiki: Transcript Parsing, Resume Offset Isolation, and Stop Races](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/wiki/transcript-and-streaming/): Offset-scoped parsing, deduplication, and provisional Stop confirmation.
- [Wiki: Multi-Turn NDJSON Daemon Protocol](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/wiki/daemon-protocol/): Stdin/stdout frames, incremental paste, and dual watchdogs.
- [Wiki: Supply-Chain Trust Root and Automated Releases](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/wiki/supply-chain-and-releases/): checksums.json trust root and merge-triggered releases.
- [Wiki: Property Suites, Coverage-Guided Fuzzing, and Lighthouse Backpressure](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/wiki/fuzzing-and-verification/): 378+ Zig tests, 31 fuzz targets, and Uphill backpressure.
- [Wiki: Smithers Cloud Factory, Object Store, and Cloud MCP Auth](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/wiki/smithers-cloud-factory/): Shared cache split, personalized UI, and one-time sandbox auth.
- [Wiki: Contributing, Public TODOs, and Untrusted Execution Policy](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/wiki/contributing-and-triage/): Untrusted execution welcome policy and person-only governance.

## Tutorials

- [Build a Commit Reviewer](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/tutorials/first-automation/): Hands-on shell script using stdin/`--input-file`, JSON output, and exit codes.
- [Drive a Multi-Turn Daemon](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/tutorials/multi-turn-daemon/): Node.js controller speaking NDJSON (`user`, `ping`, `interrupt`) to `claude-p daemon`.
- [Embed claude-p in a Zig Program](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/tutorials/embed-in-zig/): Fetching `claude_p` in Zig 0.15.2, `claude_p.run`, `stream_writer`, `extra_hooks`, and `extra_settings_json`.

## How-to guides

- [Stream Live JSON Output](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/guides/streaming-json/): Live per-message transcript streaming with `--output-format stream-json --verbose` and `jq`.
- [Resume and Continue Sessions](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/guides/resuming-sessions/): Using `--resume`, `--continue`, and `--session-id` with byte-offset isolation.
- [Nested Sessions and Auth](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/guides/nested-sessions-and-auth/): Running inside Claude Code or CI while preserving OAuth, Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry env vars.
- [Debugging and Diagnostics](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/guides/debugging-and-diagnostics/): `--debug` traces, `CLAUDE_P_PTY_TRACE`, and error diagnosis table.

## How it works

- [Architecture](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/internals/architecture/): `zmux.NativeSession`, reader thread vs main loop, hook FIFO, and module map.
- [PTY and DEC Terminal Queries](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/internals/pty-and-dec-queries/): Exact byte grammar for DA1, DA2, DSR, XTVERSION, and XTWINOPS 18t in `src/terminal.zig`.
- [Startup Dialogs and Paced Paste](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/internals/startup-dialogs-and-paste/): Claude Code 2.1 dialog FSM (`❯` verification), macOS 1024 B `TTYHOG` chunked bracketed paste (`PasteChunker`), and 4 s acceptance watchdog.
- [Hooks and Transcripts](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/internals/hooks-and-transcripts/): Inline `--settings`, opening `events.fifo` before fork, `Stop`-vs-flush retry loop, and `pread` tailing.

## Reference

- [CLI Reference](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/reference/cli/): All flags, defaults, passthrough rules, JSON result schema, environment variables, and exit codes.
- [Daemon Protocol Reference](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/reference/daemon-protocol/): Stdin/stdout NDJSON frames, interrupt handling, dual watchdogs, and `[pty-trace]`.
- [Zig Library API Reference](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/reference/zig-api/): `root.zig`, `driver.Options`, `driver.Result`, `driver.RunError`, `daemon.Options`, `hook.ExtraHook`, `emitErrorResult`, `transcript.Summary`.
- [Installation, Checksums, and Builds](https://smithersai.github.io/claude-p/reference/installation-and-builds/): Platform matrix, the `checksums.json` install trust root, Zig 0.15.2 source/cross-compile builds, and test suites.
